name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
summary: Join at age 18–40 and contribute; guaranteed pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 a month from age 60.
description: Defined pension scheme that encourages unorganised-sector workers to save voluntarily for retirement.
implementingAuthority: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (through banks and post offices)

evidence.quote: The minimum age of joining APY is 18 years and maximum age is 40 years.
The minimum age of joining APY is 18 years and maximum age is 40 years.

benefits.text: Guaranteed minimum pension of Rs. 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000 or 5000 per month from age 60, depending on contributions.

evidence.quote: Under APY, the subscribers would receive the fixed minimum pension of Rs. 1000 per month, Rs. 2000 per month, Rs. 3000 per month, Rs. 4000 per month and Rs. 5000 per month at the age of 60 years depending on their contributions

applicationProcess: Contributions can be made monthly, quarterly or half-yearly.
